svg.title: Изометрическая тяга с резинкой — положение 1
svg.desc: Original ImageGen hollow contour, vector traced. Exactly ONE centered full-body static posture. Isometric resistance-band deadlift hold, side three-quarter view. Athletic man holds a stable shallow hip hinge with hips back, neutral spine, knees slightly bent, both feet flat on floor. A long closed-loop resistance band runs under BOTH shoes and is grasped in BOTH hands near just below knee height, arms hanging straight. Show TWO taut strands clearly attached to grips and visually continuous to loop under shoes. No row, barbell, weights, cable machine, or moving arrows. One single held position with full body and whole band in view. Expert biomechanics approval pending.
